notes:
Context: mid-market SaaS (product analytics) building in-app semantic search and content recommendations. Primary engineer contact: Evan Martel (Sr. PM). Wants Hosted API to move fast for quality checks, then Dedicated for predictable nightly embedding batches and consistent query SLOs.

Requirements (from calls):
- Embedding throughput: nightly batch ~150k-250k documents (1–5 chunks each)
- Real-time search target: 50–150 QPS peak, p99 latency <120ms for vector lookup + rerank
- Vector DB: currently trialing Pinecone; wants simple bulk upsert REST path and low-cost storage tier; evaluating Milvus as fallback
- Integration: S3-to-vector ingestion pipeline, incremental upserts, idempotency on retries
- Model preferences: prefer Redwood-verified open embeddings; open to using fine-tuned or private models later
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit for price predictability but needs unit economics for nightly batches included

Security/compliance notes:
- SOC2 required for procurement; SSO (SAML) mandatory for admin console; audit logs and retention controls needed for 13-month retention policy; key management (KMS) for encryption at rest; prefer data residency in NA for EU subset customers

Sales/PS notes:
- They repeatedly asked about Dedicated autoscaling behavior under burst ingest. Concern: bulk upsert could cause throttling on vector DB side; want guidance and a recommended pattern (split by shard, backpressure config).
- Quote ask: committed Dedicated pool sized for 200 qps sustained, with occasional burst to 400 qps for daylight traffic; pricing request submitted (see drive:/deals/cobalt-queryforge/pricing-v2.pdf)

Customer quotes:
- "We need predictable cost for nightly embeddings; bursts are fine, but we cannot have batch failures silently drop vectors." — Evan M.
